notes: callee quicksort_init not inlinable (call without a scalar result used as a value): treated as an opaque call
callee quicksort_return not inlinable (pointers/arrays/structs): treated as an opaque call
callee quicksort_str not inlinable (callee with non-scalar parameter): treated as an opaque call
callee quicksort_vec not inlinable (callee with non-scalar parameter): treated as an opaque call
